mapper.sql: id, username, password, real_name, phone, email, role, balance, risk_level, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user (username, password, real_name, phone, email, role, balance, risk_level, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{role}, #{balance}, #{riskLevel}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user SET risk_level = #{riskLevel}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_user SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_user SET balance = balance + #{amount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_user ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
